title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health
slides: What if Apple studied how you use AI for health?
A new Apple app tracks real-world AI health usage
The study may reveal AI advice is often wrong
You could join the study and see your own data
Check if the app is available in your region
thread_text:
1. Your AI health advice is being watched

Apple just launched a study to track how people use AI for real-world health questions. The results might surprise you.

2. The app knows when AI is wrong

A new Apple app logs your AI health queries and cross-checks them against actual outcomes. Early data suggests AI often gives bad advice.

3. You can see your own data

Join the study and get access to a dashboard showing how your AI health usage compares to others. It's a rare look under the hood.

4. Not everyone can join

The study is region-locked for now. Check if the app is available where you live before you get excited.

5. Check your region today

Open the App Store and search for the study app. If it's not there, you're out of luck — for now.
